# Welcome

This website documents my work in AD688: Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business. It demonstrates a reproducible cloud analytics environment using AWS EC2, Python, PySpark, Quarto, Git, and GitHub.

## PySpark Demonstration

The following code creates a small PySpark dataframe containing example career-match records and displays the records with the highest scores.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-career-sample
#| tbl-cap: "Sample career-match records created with PySpark"

import os
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

os.environ["SPARK_LOCAL_IP"] = "127.0.0.1"

spark = (
    SparkSession.builder
    .master("local[1]")
    .appName("AD688QuartoDemo")
    .config("spark.driver.memory", "512m")
    .config("spark.ui.enabled", "false")
    .getOrCreate()
)

spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")

records = [
    ("Data Analyst", "Technology", 88),
    ("Business Analyst", "Finance", 84),
    ("Data Scientist", "Healthcare", 91),
    ("Machine Learning Engineer", "Technology", 95),
    ("Cloud Data Engineer", "Consulting", 89),
]

columns = ["career", "industry", "match_score"]

career_df = spark.createDataFrame(records, columns)
preview = career_df.orderBy("match_score", ascending=False).toPandas()

spark.stop()

preview
```
